name: Boots of Striding and Springing
summary: Boots that set your Speed to at least 30 feet and let you jump three times as far.

stats.effect:
While you wear these boots, your {ref:glossary/speed} becomes 30 feet unless your Speed is higher, and your Speed isn't reduced by you carrying weight in excess of your carrying capacity or wearing {ref:equipment/heavy-armor}.

Once on each of your turns, you can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.
